title: Cao, thấp, dễ thương, hiền: appearance and personality

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say you, or he, for an older man —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: anh] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say you, or she, for an older woman —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chị] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say you, for someone younger —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: em] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say so, or then —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: vậy] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say the friendly tag question, huh? —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hả] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say the light tag showing mild surprise, oh? —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: à] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Chị đó cao không?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, chị đó không cao. Chị đó thấp.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Chị đó dễ thương không?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, chị đó dễ thương. Chị đó cũng hiền.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Today, four words for describing people. Remember, the describing word comes after the noun.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: First,] [VI: cao] [EN: means tall. It has] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [EN: — flat. Listen again.] [VI_F: cao] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: cao] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: cao] [EN: Good. A tall person —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: người cao] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next, its opposite.] [VI: thấp] [EN: means short — for height. It has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: . Listen again.] [VI_F: thấp] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: thấp] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: thấp] [EN: Good. A short person —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: người thấp] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next,] [VI: dễ thương] [EN: means cute, or lovable. Listen to its two parts.] [VI_F: dễ] [EN: has] [EN: a dipping tone — it falls, then rises] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: thương] [EN: has] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [EN: . Listen to the whole word again.] [VI_F: dễ thương] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: dễ thương] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dễ thương] [EN: Good. So cute —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dễ thương quá!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Last,] [VI: hiền] [EN: means gentle, or kind-natured. It has] [EN: a falling tone] [EN: . Listen again.] [VI_F: hiền] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: hiền] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hiền] [EN: Good. She is gentle —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị đó hiền.]

[EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tall —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: cao] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Short —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: thấp] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Cute, lovable —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dễ thương] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Gentle, kind-natured —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hiền] [EN: Good.]
